data.name: Azrah
data.gender_notes: Azrah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'azara', which means 'to help' or 'to support'. In Islamic tradition, Azrah is believed to be a name of the Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) daughter. The name Azrah carries the meaning “Helpful, Supportive” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azrah usually hope their child will grow to embody helpful, supportive and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Azrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helpful, Supportive.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azrah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
